about: The IGME5000 unit code (GEO) and polygon record number (0-based, the same in the .shp and the .dbf) at each of the 25 points of every box, row-major: row 0 = the southern row (-4 km), column 0 = the western column (-4 km). 'units' holds each unit's own fields from the DBF. Written by scripts/screening_geology.py.

source.credit: IGME5000, © BGR, Hannover, 2005, https://doi.org/10.25928/igme-5000, modified: reclassified to Analog Atlas rock ids

sampling.method: 5 x 5 points per box at -4, -2, 0, +2 and +4 km north and east of the box centre, placed with compute_terrain.destination() on a sphere of R = 6,371,008.8 m and rounded to 6 decimals; each point takes the unit of the IGME5000 polygon that holds it
